James Weldon Johnson, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/james-weldon-johnson/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- James Weldon Johnson, the author, died 1938 (Wikidata Q478450). Citizenship: United States.

First publication of the text used: 1899 to 1927 (SE colophon: 'Poetry was compiled from poems published between 1899 and 1927 by James Weldon Johnson.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: works published before 1931 are in the public domain in the United States. The colophon dates the poems to 1899 through 1927. The edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the same.
- Country of origin (not stated by the colophon): the possible countries are the United States, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life plus 70 years or less for this death, so the text is public domain in each of them by 1 January 2009. The last person to die among the people whose words are in the text is James Weldon Johnson, in 1938.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
